memberdef.name: XPm_RequestSuspend

briefdescription.para: This function is used by a PU to request suspend of another PU.

detaileddescription.para: This call triggers the power management controller to notify the PU identified by 'nodeID' that a suspend has been requested. This will allow said PU to gracefully suspend itself by calling XPm_SelfSuspend for each of its CPU nodes, or else call XPm_AbortSuspend with its PU node as argument and specify the reason.

parameterdescription.para: Node ID of the PU node to be suspended
Requested acknowledge type
Maximum wake-up latency requirement in us(micro sec)
Instead of specifying a maximum latency, a PU can also explicitly request a certain power state.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code

If 'ack' is set to PM_ACK_NON_BLOCKING, the requesting PU will be notified upon completion of suspend or if an error occurred, such as an abort. REQUEST_ACK_BLOCKING is not supported for this command.

briefdescription.para: This function is called by a PU to add or remove a wake-up source prior to going to suspend.

detaileddescription.para: The list of wake sources for a PU is automatically cleared whenever the PU is woken up or when one of its CPUs aborts the suspend procedure.

parameterdescription.para: Node ID of the target to be woken up.
Node ID of the wakeup device.

Enable flag:
1 : the wakeup source is added to the list
0 : the wakeup source is removed from the list

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
Declaring a node as a wakeup source will ensure that the node will not be powered off. It also will cause the PMU to configure the GIC Proxy accordingly if the FPD is powered off.

memberdef.argsstring: (u32 type, u32 subtype)
memberdef.name: XPm_SystemShutdown

briefdescription.para: This function can be used by a privileged PU to shut down or restart the complete device.

parameterdescription.para:
Should the system be restarted automatically?
PM_SHUTDOWN : no restart requested, system will be powered off permanently
PM_RESTART : restart is requested, system will go through a full reset
Restart subtype (SYSTEM or PS_ONLY or SUBSYSTEM)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code

In either case the PMU will call XPm_InitSuspendCb for each of the other PUs, allowing them to gracefully shut down. If a PU is asleep it will be woken up by the PMU. The PU making the XPm_SystemShutdown should perform its own suspend procedure after calling this API. It will not receive an init suspend callback.

detaileddescription.para: Using this API call a PU requests access to a slave device and asserts its requirements on that device. Provided the PU is sufficiently privileged, the PMU will enable access to the memory mapped region containing the control registers of that device. parameterdescription.para: Node ID of the PM slave requested

PM_CAP_WAKEUP : emit wake interrupts

Requested acknowledge type

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code

memberdef.name: XPm_GetNodeStatus

briefdescription.para: This function is used to obtain information about the current state of a component.

detaileddescription.para: The caller must pass a pointer to an XPm_NodeStatus structure, which must be pre-allocated by the caller.

parameterdescription.para: ID of the component or sub-system in question.
Used to return the complete status of the node.

listitem.para:
status - The current power state of the requested node.
For CPU nodes:
0 : if CPU is off (powered down),
1 : if CPU is active (powered up),
2 : if CPU is in sleep (powered down),
3 : if CPU is suspending (powered up)
For power islands and power domains:
0 : if island is powered down,
1 : if island is powered up
For PM slaves:
0 : if slave is powered down,
1 : if slave is powered up,
2 : if slave is in retention
requirement - Slave nodes only: Returns current requirements the requesting PU has requested of the node.

usage - Slave nodes only: Returns current usage status of the node:
0 : node is not used by any PU,
1 : node is used by caller exclusively,
2 : node is used by other PU(s) only,
3 : node is used by caller and by other PU(s)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
None

memberdef.argsstring: (XPm_Notifier *const notifier)
memberdef.name: XPm_RegisterNotifier

briefdescription.para: A PU can call this function to request that the power management controller call its notify callback whenever a qualifying event occurs.

detaileddescription.para: One can request to be notified for a specific or any event related to a specific node.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the notifier object to be associated with the requested notification. The notifier object contains the following data related to the notification:

listitem.para: nodeID : ID of the node to be notified about,
eventID : ID of the event in question, '-1' denotes all events ( - EVENT_STATE_CHANGE, EVENT_ZERO_USERS),
wake : true: wake up on event, false: do not wake up (only notify if awake), no buffering/queueing

callback : Pointer to the custom callback function to be called when the notification is available. The callback executes from interrupt context, so the user must take special care when implementing the callback. Callback is optional, may be set to NULL.
received : Variable indicating how many times the notification has been received since the notifier is registered.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
The caller shall initialize the notifier object before invoking the XPm_RegisteredNotifier function. While notifier is registered, the notifier object shall not be modified by the caller.
